channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alperen Sengun | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alperen Sengun from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steven Adams on Jabari Smith, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Steven Adams on mentoring Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Sengun:

“I just go the old school just bullying tactic. Just bully them. That's just fun. Especially the Turkish people, mate. Got to bully those guys. But no, it's been good, honestly, mentoring them and just seeing the growth. It is still exciting and just again, competing at that level and seeing the growth throughout the year, not just as an individual, but as a team.”

Steven Adams on Jabari Smith, Alperen Sengun, Aug 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Lakers coach JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton’s Flagrant 2 and elbow to Alperen Sengun:

“DA is — he's got such a sweet, just like, kind soul. And, no, that wasn't dirty or intentional. It looked, you know, from our vantage point, like he was trying to brace himself with that off arm.”

JJ Redick on Deandre Ayton, Alperen Sengun, Apr 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Reed Sheppard on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Matt Young:Reed Sheppard on his costly turnover that allowed the Lakers to send the game to overtime:

“It was a stupid turnover. Alpi’s (Alperen Sengun) man came up, I should have hit Alpi and just made the simple play, but I tried to split the two defenders.”

Reed Sheppard on Alperen Sengun, Apr 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
[RocketsWire]Udoka on coaching Sengun hard:

“When I got here, he asked for it. He said, ‘I don’t want you to sweep anything under the rug. Be direct and blunt.’We’ll have our debates back and forth during games, which I don’t mind at all.”

Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun, Apr 17, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
‪Erin Grugan: Former Sixers' player Furkan Korkmaz said back in Sept. 2025:

“Until now I thought Joel Embiid was the best player, best center I was playing with, but I think we can tell it's Alperen Sengun now”

Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun, Jan 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
As Schroder said, explaining the success of the team:

“Unbelievable! The strech we had, 9-0. We also had that two years ago in the World Cup. To go 9-0 this summer and in this game. First off, sorry, Turkey played one hell of a game, Sengun, Larkin, all those guys, Sipahi hit a bit three, but as the coach said, we never shy away from big moments. It’s not just Franz, not just me, it’s all our team. Bonga, Andy Obst, it was a big effort by everyone. Big-time plays by big-time characters. I am so proud of these guys because we stayed together as a team. It’s big time being World Cup Champions and Eurobasket winners”

Dennis Schroder on Alperen Sengun, Sep 14, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
“I think Joel Embiid was the best player, best center I was playing with, but I think we can tell that it's Alperen [Sengun] now,”

Furkan Korkmaz on Joel Embiid, Alperen Sengun, Sep 9, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Vassilis Spanoulis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Lauri Markkanen, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Vassilis Spanoulis:

“At least to times, he should have been awarded unsportmanlike fouls, and we have to face everybody with the same criteria. If we face Luka, Jokic, and Sengun, Markkanen, like this, we have to face Giannis the same way. Just 12 free throws are few for Giannis; he could have had another 10 for sure. We have a team in which we respect everybody, and first of all, me, as a person, I respect a lot coach Scariolo and Spain, which has accomplished amazing things over the last 15 years, but I have to be fair with myself and the game, and to say the truth”

Vassilis Spanoulis on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nikola Jokic, Lauri Markkanen, Alperen Sengun, Sep 4, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Djordje Sijan on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
And this summer, Sengun worked with Sijan on his shooting:

“We mostly worked on shooting… I went through Partizan’s school with centers, and I can say that Sengun is the best player with his back to the basket in Europe. In the NBA, they focused on where he is dominant, and he developed to perfection. But creativity was forbidden to him. I was asked in an interview, ‘What did you do with him?’ Nothing, I let him get off the shots from all possible positions. Some coaches don’t like it. But this year we worked mostly on the three-point shot. That shot was forbidden to him”

Djordje Sijan on Alperen Sengun, Aug 21, 2025. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Draymond Green on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
“You know, I’ve played against a lot of guys. I always tell people that in playoff series one of two things happen: Either you completely lose respect for someone or you gain a lot of respect for someone … You get to see who is really real. So Sengun is real. He ain’t back down at all. “[But]what I would say to Sengun — flop a little less. Embellish a little less,”

Draymond Green on Alperen Sengun, May 7, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Danielle Lerner:Rafael Stone:

“We are not a team built around any one player offensively, whether it’s Jalen, Alperen or Amen.”

Rafael Stone on Alperen Sengun, May 6, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Ime Udoka on if he expects Alperen Sengun back in the next few games:

“Yes I do expect him back on this road trip for sure.”

Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun, Feb 3, 2025. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Rafael Stone:

“Alperen has established himself as one of the game’s great young big men. Heplays the game with a contagious joy and flair that is truly unique. We believe in the person and player that he is and ... that he is becoming.”

Rafael Stone on Alperen Sengun, Oct 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Free throws, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun potentially improving this season as a free throw shooter and defender:

“I've never really taken Alperen (out of a game) due to free throws. Defensively, that's a different thing, obviously. At times, you want to be able to switch and have favorable matchups on that end. [Improvement] will keep him on the floor, as it does a lot of guys, but we're very specific with who we sub at the end of games specifically for offense and defense. The better he is, the more he will be out there.”

Ime Udoka on Free throws, Alperen Sengun, Oct 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Jalen Green, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Mitty: Ime Udoka on why Alperen Sengun being out is not the reason for Jalen Green’s resurgence:

“We wanted to really increase the pace and get the threes up and all those things don’t have anything to do with Alpi- When Jalen was struggling earlier in the year he had the same quality looks and Jalen started to read the game better - I think they can complement each other very well”

Ime Udoka on Jalen Green, Alperen Sengun, Mar 28, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
#Rockets HC Ime Udoka on Sengun:

“Some relief. Hate to see him miss time in general. Best news is nothing broken, no ligaments torn.”

Ime Udoka on Alperen Sengun, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @KellyIko.

item.title: Willie Green on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Pelicans coachWillie Green on Alperen Sengun:

“He's playing at an All-Star level. He's a handful. Everybody knows it.”

Willie Green on Alperen Sengun, Jan 31, 2024. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
“Sengun is such a talented, smart basketball player, he would have definitely made my life easy. The way he can score the ball, he can share the ball, you don’t typically see those things in a young player. He’ll continue to grow and continue to be great. He’s a tough cover. You can see he’s a winning basketball player. Just being (in Milwaukee) and seeing the way Giannis and I benefit one another; we have games that definitely fit together and improve each other and the team. I think obviously, as great as (Şengün) is at what he does, we could have meshed similarly.”

Brook Lopez on Alperen Sengun, Jan 6, 2024. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Alperen Sengun
item.description:
David Hardisty:Kevin Durant on which young players he really enjoys watching play:

“I would say I was going to give some love to Alperen Sengün. I like Sengun. He was dunking on a couple of people. I didn't know he could get up like that. He's nice. I like him.”

Kevin Durant on Alperen Sengun, Jan 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Clyde Drexler, Hakeem Olajuwon, Calvin Murphy, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Mark Berman:Stephen Silas on Hakeem Olajuwon working with @Alperen Sengun:

“Having Hakeem teaching you is like unbelievable. One of the great things of being a Houston Rocket you have so many people willing to help especially guys like him, Rudy T, Calvin Murphy.. Clyde Drexler.. It’s great.”

Stephen Silas on Clyde Drexler, Hakeem Olajuwon, Calvin Murphy, Alperen Sengun, Feb 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
